responsibility: This file handles Rust frontend metadata I/O at the object-file level. It computes target-aware field alignment, writes serialized Rust export data into a dedicated object section during compilation, and reads that section back from object files or archive members using GCC's `simple-object` helpers, so it owns the low-level persistence path for Rust crate metadata exchanged between compilation units.
same_name_distinction: Implements the low-level object-file metadata routines declared in `rust-object-export.h`: target-aware field alignment calculation, writing Rust export bytes into the `.rust_export` section, and reading that section back with `simple-object` helpers. Unlike the header, this `.cc` file performs the actual section I/O and object/archive handling.
